components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered, in ISO format 'YYYY-MM-DD'. Optional on create; defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner already shares the same last name and address. Optional; not persisted.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: Assigned customer code formatted '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>', where CITY3 is the upper-cased first three letters of city, LAST3 the upper-cased first three letters of lastName and NNNN a per-city 4-digit zero-padded sequence.
              type: string
              example: 'LON-SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: Assigned membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>', where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: 'LON-SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A stable shared identifier assigned when an owner joins a household (same last name and address) via 'sharesHousehold'. All owners of the same household share this value.
              type: string
              example: 'H-3F9A2C1D5E8B'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners (before this owner was created) sharing the same firstName and lastName, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipTier:
              title: Membership tier
              description: "'SILVER' when namesakeCount is 0 and an email is present, otherwise 'BRONZE'."
              type: string
              example: 'SILVER'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:

## Summary

I implemented the `locality` field, derived from the owner's city via the fixed table (Sydney→NSW, Melbourne→VIC, Brisbane→QLD), returning `UNKNOWN` for any other city.

Changes:
1. **`src/main/resources/openapi.yml`** — added a read-only `locality` property to the `Owner` response schema, so the generated `OwnerDto` carries the field.
2. **`src/main/java/.../mapper/CityRegion.java`** (new) — a small helper holding the fixed city→region map with a `locality(city)` lookup.
3. **`src/main/java/.../mapper/OwnerMapper.java`** — a `@Mapping` on `toOwnerDto` that populates `locality` from `owner.getCity()` via `CityRegion.locality(...)`.

### One trap worth flagging
My first attempt put the `locality(String)` logic as a `default` method directly on `OwnerMapper`. That silently broke owner **creation**: MapStruct treats any `String → String` method on a mapper as a candidate mapping method and hijacked the string-field mappings in `toOwner(OwnerFieldsDto)`, so the E.164-normalized telephone never reached the entity and persistence failed with a 500 `ConstraintViolationException`. Moving the logic into the standalone `CityRegion` class (referenced by fully-qualified name in the expression) keeps it out of MapStruct's method-resolution scope and fixes it. The full suite is green.
